verdict.rationale: Slate documents parallel orchestration of many different tasks through background subagents shown as inline cards. Nothing in the evidence describes running several attempts of the same task side by side, comparing their outputs, or choosing a winning attempt. Parallelizing separate tasks is an adjacent feature, not best-of-N attempt comparison, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
